subject: Urgent: INV-4927 — failed card + token expiry, 3DS fallback & VAT evidence
body:
--- Message 1 of 4 ---
From: Acme Payments <payments@acme-corp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-4927 failed (card expired/token)

Hi Marissa,

We just received a failed-payment notice for INV-4927 — our finance team shows the recurring charge declined with code 'card_declined' and the metadata says token expired. We tried updating the card on file but our portal shows the saved token belongs to your gateway (we don't have the raw card). Can you confirm options for Acme to update the card or accept a one-time payment link? Also we need VAT confirmation — the invoice shows our VAT number but our AP team got an acquirer AVS mismatch on their end (EU cross-border).

We need to avoid a chargeback — can Redwood suspend the invoice temporarily while we resolve?

Thanks,
Lina Gonzalez
Head of AP, Acme Corp
payments@acme-corp.com

Attachments: dunning-log.txt (plain text)

--- Message 2 of 4 ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Acme Payments <payments@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Nov 2027 11:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Invoice INV-4927 failed (card expired/token)

Hi Lina — thanks for the heads up and sorry for the noise. Quick summary of options and our recommended next steps so we can keep this out of dispute: 

1) Immediate one-time pay link: we can generate a one-time hosted payment link that accepts card or bank transfer. This avoids token exchange issues and is the fastest path.
2) Card rotation via Stripe: if you prefer us to re-sync the token, we need the cardholder to re-authenticate (3DS) via a secure flow. We can trigger a 3DS retry; this normally succeeds for EU cards that require SCA.
3) Invoice split & partial-sca: if VAT alignment is the blocker, we can split the invoice into product and VAT line items and submit VAT evidence to acquirers (you provided your VAT cert — attach below).
4) Temporary hold: we can mark the invoice as 'in review' for up to 7 days to avoid automated collection/chargeback escalation while you complete steps 1–3.

Recommended sequence: generate a one-time pay link (option 1) as fallback while we open a 3DS retry (option 2) and simultaneously submit the VAT docs to the acquirer (option 3). If Stripe reports a soft-decline, we can also create a small $1 authorization to force cardholder verification before retrying full amount.

I attached: INV-4927.pdf (invoice) and acme_vat_registration.pdf (what you sent).

Do you want me to: (A) create the pay link now, (B) open a 3DS retry with Stripe, or (C) both? If you choose both, please confirm the best contact email for the 3DS challenge (cardholder email).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: INV-4927.pdf (pdf), acme_vat_registration.pdf (pdf)

--- Message 3 of 4 ---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Stripe Support <support+redwood@stripe.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2027 08:17:00 -05:00
Subject: Fwd: Invoice INV-4927 failed — request 3DS retry & acquirer evidence (ticket STR-5561)

Hi Stripe team — forwarding a live customer case (Acme Corp) where a recurring token expired and the acquirer flagged a VAT/AVS mismatch. We need help with two asks: 

1) Start a 3DS re-authentication flow tied to the existing customer object in our account (customer_redwood_acme_4927). If possible, allow us to surface the 3DS challenge as a hosted page we can send to the cardholder (payments@acme-corp.com will confirm the email).
2) Guidance on evidence submission for cross-border VAT: we've attached the customer's VAT cert. If the acquirer needs specific fields in the settlement metadata, please confirm the field keys and whether we should open an evidence upload to the dispute/transaction record.

Merchant: Acme Corp (customer_redwood_acme_4927)
Invoice: INV-4927
Amount: EUR 24,350.00
Decline code: card_declined (token_expired / acquirer_avs_mismatch)
Attached: INV-4927.pdf, acme_vat_registration.pdf, dunning-log.txt

Please route this to payments-integration and let us know next steps and expected SLA. Ticket created: STR-5561 (please confirm).

Thanks,
Marissa

--- Message 4 of 4 ---
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 16 Nov 2027 14:03:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: INV-4927 — failed card + token expiry, 3DS fallback & VAT evidence

Quick internal note — approve offering a 1-time 50% payment extension or a partial waiver? Finance says we can offer a 72-hour payment link and hold the invoice if we mark it 'in review'. I also recommend we allow the 3DS flow simultaneously to avoid impacting renewal.

If you want, I can approve a small one-off credit (up to EUR 500) to smooth the collection if Acme agrees to immediate payment of the remainder. 

LMK and I'll sign off.

-Aditya
